Quick legal note on sequencing & redlines:
- We agree NDA first (quick review), then DPA if we see any non-standard data processing clauses, then MSA.
- For MSA redlines, we prefer to receive the customer's mark-up (Acme's MSA) first so we can identify deal-breaking clauses up front.
- Typical Redwood turnaround commitments we can offer: NDA 48 hours; initial MSA redline 5-7 business days (depending on complexity); subsequent rounds may extend.

Requirements from Acme to speed review:
- Share Acme's preferred MSA (we need the full doc, not just a clause list).
- Provide SOC2 report link and any outstanding security questionnaire answers.

If Acme insists on major indemnity/liability changes, flag to Rishi and Marissa early so we can align with Finance.

I'll take point on NDA/DPA reviews. We'll plan for an initial review within 48 business hours once we have Acme's NDA or if they sign ours.
